title: Message to a school contact
body:
Hello [school contact's name / role],

I am writing to report a harmful deepfake or non-consensual image/video involving a student, [classmate's name]. I first noticed it on [platform / where you saw it] around [date or time].

I have preserved evidence (screenshots, links, usernames) and have not shared the content further. Please advise on the school's next steps and how to protect [classmate's name] from further harm.

Thank you,
[your name]
[your grade / class, if helpful]
